initial_failures.memory_race: Minimal private retrieval corpus lacked the owner/revision tables now observed by ranking capture; dense assertion used semantic instead of the actual semantic_parent fusion arm. Fixed without changing corpus labels.
initial_failures.lint: Replay test used a literal /tmp directory. Fixed to honor TMPDIR and remove its owned directory.
initial_failures.T3: Native refresh recovery could accept a read before the terminating Go owner had exited; its next worker refused unavailable. Recovery harness now waits for old process exit before proving the replacement can serve the committed identity.

cli_probe: An unknown-request lookup during deliberate owner suspension returned unavailable. After recovery the explicit UDS CLI lookup returned complete with an empty receipt list.

evidence_limits.ranking_universe: bounded owner-admitted candidates; SQL-excluded hidden records are not enumerated
evidence_limits.source_family: not_assessed when retrieval supplies no claim-specific lineage projection
evidence_limits.replay: exact encrypted final payload, not recomputation of ranking
evidence_limits.expiry: one-hour replay access; lazy ciphertext deletion on lookup, or explicit forget
evidence_limits.provider_effects: HTTP acknowledgement does not certify remote effects
